decisions.rationale: Lactic acidosis is a type of high anion gap metabolic acidosis, but the lactic acid level was not high enough to explain the degree of acidosis
Ketoacidosis is a type of high anion gap metabolic acidosis, but the blood ketone level was not elevated
Salicylate toxicity is a type of high anion gap metabolic acidosis, but the salicylate level was not elevated
Uremic acidosis is a type of high anion gap metabolic acidosis, but the creatinine level was not high enough to explain the degree of acidosis
Toxic alcohol ingestion, such as ethylene glycol poisoning, is a type of high anion gap metabolic acidosis, and the osmolar gap was mildly elevated
None is not a valid diagnosis
